verification_duration_ms.description: Server challenge issuance to submission; excludes time before issuance.
verification_duration_ms.overlap: Manual 6-12 ms overlaps automation 8-29 ms. This measures the post-click protocol, not human reaction time.
verification_duration_ms.possible_false_positive_concerns: Network delay, device load, accessibility and retries affect duration.

request_event_ordering.description: Ordered server arrivals and lifecycle events, linked by request ordinal.
request_event_ordering.overlap: Descriptive comparison only: 5 successful manual Chrome runs versus 15 scripted runs under different collection conditions; no validated classifier.
request_event_ordering.possible_false_positive_concerns: Concurrent requests can complete out of arrival order.

navigation_transitions.description: Route categories observed at the server.
navigation_transitions.overlap: Descriptive comparison only: 5 successful manual Chrome runs versus 15 scripted runs under different collection conditions; no validated classifier.
navigation_transitions.possible_false_positive_concerns: Prefetch, caches and back/forward cache obscure browser navigation.

challenge_retries.description: Additional challenge issuances and submission attempts.
challenge_retries.overlap: Descriptive comparison only: 5 successful manual Chrome runs versus 15 scripted runs under different collection conditions; no validated classifier.
challenge_retries.possible_false_positive_concerns: Connectivity failures and expired challenges affect legitimate users.

refresh_behavior.description: Repeated route categories; refresh cannot be identified conclusively.
refresh_behavior.overlap: Descriptive comparison only: 5 successful manual Chrome runs versus 15 scripted runs under different collection conditions; no validated classifier.
refresh_behavior.possible_false_positive_concerns: Reload, repeated fetch and new navigation can look identical.

request_bursts.description: Interarrival intervals without a classification threshold.
request_bursts.overlap: Descriptive comparison only: 5 successful manual Chrome runs versus 15 scripted runs under different collection conditions; no validated classifier.
request_bursts.possible_false_positive_concerns: Page assets, parallel tabs and network batching create bursts.

experiment_interaction.description: Existing experiment exposure and activation families.
experiment_interaction.overlap: Manual Chrome, normal visible-flow Playwright and StopIn-aware adversary all have no activations.
experiment_interaction.possible_false_positive_concerns: Tools/extensions may follow resources; informed automation may ignore them.

session_continuity.description: Existing server validation and continuity observations.
session_continuity.overlap: Manual runs and allowed automation both issue sessions and validate subsequent protected requests.
session_continuity.possible_false_positive_concerns: Cookie restrictions, expiry and fresh contexts interrupt continuity.

optional_telemetry.description: Presence of browser field on parsed verification submissions.
optional_telemetry.overlap: Telemetry present in all five manual runs and normal visible-flow/resource/protocol automation runs.
optional_telemetry.possible_false_positive_concerns: Script blocking and privacy tools can omit telemetry; claims can be spoofed.

provenance.label_basis: Operator confirmed manual Chrome operation in conversation after reviewing results (3)

manual.outcome: All five included completed runs verified and received ALLOW plus HTTP 200 for protected page and API
manual.identity_basis: Operator assertion, not independent human verification

automation.note: Test-only request budget; CLI uses pacing with configured limits.

collection_context.limitations: Separate batches and origins; one manual operator, small samples. Earlier 503 and mixed-dropdown exploratory batches are excluded from this successful-flow comparison, not erased.
